levels.surface: أحمد بن زياد بن جعفر الهمداني

notes: The chain stands after the saying («حدثنا بذلك»): it is the isnad of the Imam's answer about the verse; the verse and the compiler's remarks are not chain
«و غيره» is an unnamed co-transmitter; «أبيه» is Ali b. Ibrahim's father (relation); the Imam is after «عن», so a narrator (owner ruling 2)

«
» and «رضى الله عنه» are markup and honorifics, left out
